ValidationRule.description: Restrict the status changes to go backwards.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' || RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' || RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry_CMOS') && !ISNew() && ISCHANGED(Status) && IF( CASE(Text(PRIORVALUE(Status)), "Open", CASE(Text(Status), "Under Investigation", 1, "Escalated",1, "Withdrawn",1, "Provisionally Closed",1, "Closed",1, 0), "Under Investigation", CASE(Text(Status), "Escalated", 1, "Withdrawn",1, "Provisionally Closed",1, "Closed",1, 0), "Escalated", CASE(Text(Status), "Withdrawn", 1, "Provisionally Closed",1, "Closed",1, 0), "Withdrawn", CASE(Text(Status), "Re-opened", 1, 0), "Closed", CASE(Text(Status), "Re-opened", 1, 0), "Re-opened", CASE(Text(Status), "Under Investigation", 1, "Escalated",1, "Withdrawn",1, "Provisionally Closed",1, "Closed",1, 0), "Provisionally Closed", CASE(Text(Status), "Re-opened", 1, "Closed",1, 0), "Resolved", CASE(Text(Status), "Re-opened", 1, 0), 1)=0, true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is not a valid status in complaint process.
